name: Slasher Host
text: Army marker for the Nighthaunt Slasher Host. Its battle traits, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: Ethereal
text: Ignore all modifiers, good and bad, to save rolls for friendly units. A weapon's Rend is one of them, so the save is the bare die against the Save characteristic.

name: Wave of Terror
text: In any charge phase, after a friendly unit has made a charge move with a charge roll of 10 or more, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it. That enemy unit has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

name: Death Stalkers
text: Once, at the start of the first battle round, pick any enemy unit. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used for attacks that target that unit have +1 Rend.

name: Chorus of Terror
text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target a friendly unit that charged this turn.

name: Discorporate
text: In your hero phase, pick a friendly unit wholly within 9" of this unit (this unit counts). It has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

name: Drawn to War
text: Your general has Ward (4+) while it is within 1" of this unit.

name: Reaped Like Corn
text: Combat attacks made by this unit score a critical hit on an unmodified hit roll of 5+ instead of 6 while the target unit has 5 or more models.

name: Chilling Horde
text: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks if it charged this turn.

name: Soulfire Ring
text: At the end of any turn, if the bearer slew any models in combat this turn, Heal (D6) the bearer.

name: Cloaked in Shadow
text: In each phase, only 1 enemy unit can pick the bearer as a target of its attacks. The first enemy unit that targets the bearer that phase keeps the claim.

name: Beacon of Nagashizzar
text: Once per battle, in your hero phase, return 1 slain model to each friendly unit on the battlefield.

name: Shadow's Edge
text: The bearer's Sword of Stolen Hours has Crit (Mortal) as well as Crit (Auto-wound). Pick one before the attack.
